title: potentilla recta subsp. hirta
intro: Potentilla recta subsp. hirta, commonly known as the Rough-leaved Cinquefoil, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla recta subsp. hirta include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been found to exhibit potential in protecting against oxidative stress and promoting overall well-being.
